newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC mkt closes up, fresh foreign interest.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC mkt closes up, fresh foreign interest.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed firmer on Monday, extending a rally from foreign investors started last week.

Traders said there had been fresh foreign interest in high-caps on Monday and anticipated further growing demand for key market attractions including cement makers and oil refineries throughout the week.
Gainers led the decliners by 167 to 77, with 351 stocks marking time.

Three independent indices, computed by brokerage houses on the basis of average prices and market capitalisation, went up from Friday's session. The VAB-RA all-share index rose by 4.2 percent to 4,851.7 points, BIG-OTC went up by 4.87 percent to 3,830.6 and CAS-RQ gained 4.52 percent to 873 points.
Cement maker Romcim, most heavily traded in recent months, closed 3,000 lei stronger at 96,000. An uptrend in its price was seen ahead.
Oil refineries Arpechim and Petromidia closed 2,000 and 500 lei higher at 36,000 and 38,000 respectively under buying pressure.
Steel mill Sidex closed flat at 22,000 lei, despite deals throuhgout the session struck at 22,500.
Overall, turnover fell to 21.81 billion from 25.14 billion on Friday.
